title: AI Integration Services
desc: We connect LLMs — GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, or open-source models — into your existing software via a versioned abstraction layer. Your stack stays intact; intelligence gets added on top.

title: Workflow Automation
desc: We automate document-heavy and repetitive operational processes — invoice processing, approvals, onboarding — using AI for judgment calls and deterministic logic for everything else.

title: Conversational AI & Chatbots
desc: We build AI assistants that work on your website, WhatsApp, Slack, or inside your product — answering from your knowledge base, routing to humans when needed.

title: Intelligent Document Processing
desc: We extract structured data from invoices, contracts, forms, and medical records using AI — automatically classifying, extracting, validating, and routing to the right system.

title: AI Readiness Assessment
desc: A structured, free assessment of your organisation's AI readiness — data access, use case clarity, infrastructure, and team capability. Delivered as a written report within 48 hours.

title: AI Governance & Ethics
desc: We build oversight frameworks for AI systems — bias auditing, explainability, EU AI Act alignment, and risk management documentation — so your AI deployment is auditable and defensible.
